mapper.select: select gfps.*,sd.D_Name as gfpsProjectCompetentDepartmentName from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps left join SYS_Department sd on gfps.Gfps_Project_Competent_Department_Id = sd.D_ID where gfps.id = #{id} and gfps.del_flag = 0

select gfpsd.*, pp.P_Name as pname,pp.P_Name as projectName,gfp.Project_ID as projectId, pp.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal,pp.P_Approve_Budget_Code as pApproveBudgetCode, pp.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget,ibd.bd_approval_num as bdApprovalNum, gfp.Gfp_Project_Progress as gfpProjectProgress, gfp.Gfp_Arrived_Funds as gfpArrivedFunds, gfp.Gfp_Balance_Funds as gfpBalanceFunds, gfp.Gfp_Member_Balance_Funds as gfpMemberBalanceFunds, gfp.Gfp_Fund_Demand_Amount as gfpFundDemandAmount, gfp.Gfp_Fund_Apply_Amount as gfpFundApplyAmount, gfp.Gfp_Arrange_Funds as gfpArrangeFunds, gfp.Gfp_Next_Month_Funds as gfpNextMonthFunds, gfp.Gfp_Fund_Apply_Amount_GC_Audit as gfpFundApplyAmountGcAudit, gfp.Gfp_Fund_Apply_Amount_CW_Audit as gfpFundApplyAmountCwAudit, sd.D_Name as gfpsProjectCompetentDepartmentName,gfp.Project_Total as projectTotal from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary_Detail gfpsd left join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps on gfpsd.Gfps_Id = gfps.Id left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp on gfpsd.Gfp_Id = gfp.Id left join Pre_Project pp on gfp.Project_ID = pp.P_ID left join Inv_Budget_Declare ibd on pp.P_ID = ibd.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on gfpsd.Gfps_Project_Competent_Department_Id = sd.D_ID where gfpsd.Gfps_Id = #{id} and gfpsd.status = 0 and gfpsd.del_flag = 0 and gfps.del_flag = 0 and gfp.del_flag = 0 order by sd.d_Sort

select distinct gfps.Id from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary_Detail gfpsd left join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps on gfpsd.Gfps_Id = gfps.Id where gfpsd.Gfp_Id=#{gfpId} and gfpsd.status =0 and gfpsd.del_flag =0 and gfps.gfps_type = 1 and gfps.del_flag = 0

select mn.*, mn.id as gfpId, pp.P_Competent_Department as gfpsProjectCompetentDepartmentId, sd1.D_Name as gfpsProjectCompetentDepartmentName, pp.P_Department as gfpsProjectDepartmentId, sd2.D_Name as gfpsProjectDepartmentName, pp.P_Name as pname, pp.P_Name as projectName, gfp2.groupCount from Group_Fund_Plan mn left join Pre_Project pp on mn.Project_ID = pp.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd1 on pp.P_Competent_Department = sd1.D_Id left join SYS_Department sd2 on pp.P_Department = sd2.D_Id left join ( select Group_Id, count(1) as groupCount from Group_Fund_Plan where del_flag = 0 group by Group_Id ) gfp2 on mn.Group_Id = gfp2.Group_Id where mn.Gfp_Year = #{params.gfpsYear} and mn.Gfp_Month = #{params.gfpsMonth} and mn.del_flag = 0 and pp.P_Competent_Department in
#{item}
and mn.Gfp_Fund_Apply_Amount > 0
and mn.group_Type = #{params.groupType}
and mn.state = 7 and not exists (select 1 from Group_Fund_Plan gfp where gfp.Group_Id = mn.Group_Id and gfp.del_flag = 0 and (gfp.Group_Main_Type is null or gfp.Group_Main_Type = '' or (gfp.Group_Main_Type = '0' and gfp.State != 7 and gfp.State != 3)))
and exists(select 1 from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps left join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary_Detail gfpsd on gfps.id = gfpsd.Gfps_Id left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp_sub on gfpsd.Gfp_Id = gfp_sub.Id where gfp_sub.Group_Id = mn.Group_Id and gfps.State = 7 and gfps.del_flag = 0 and gfpsd.del_flag = 0 and gfpsd.status = 0 and gfps.Gfps_Type = 1)
and mn.Group_Main_Type = '1' order by mn.Create_Time desc
select * from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0

select mn.*, gfps.id as gfpsId from Group_Fund_Plan mn left join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary_Detail gfpsd on mn.Id = gfpsd.Gfp_Id left join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps on gfpsd.Gfps_Id = gfps.Id where mn.Project_ID = #{params.pId} and gfps.Gfps_Type = #{params.gfpsType} and mn.state = 7 and mn.del_flag = 0 and gfpsd.del_flag = 0 and gfps.del_flag = 0 and gfps.State = 7 and gfps.Group_Main_Type = 'new' and exists (select 1 from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary_Detail gfpsd inner join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps on gfpsd.Gfps_Id = gfps.id where gfpsd.Gfp_Id = mn.id and gfpsd.del_flag = 0 and gfpsd.status = 0 and gfps.State = 7 and gfps.del_flag = 0)

select count(1) from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary_Detail gfpsd left join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps on gfpsd.Gfps_Id = gfps.Id where gfpsd.Gfp_Id = #{id} and gfpsd.del_flag = 0 and gfpsd.status = 0 and gfps.del_flag = 0 and gfps.state != 3
